dog.description_text: Meet Peppermint! 🐾 This sweet girl enjoys going for walks and tolerates all handling. She can be a bit anxious in the care center, so a calm, patient home may help her feel more comfortable and secure. Peppermint was found as a stray with other dogs, but little else is known about her history. With time, love, and reassurance, she may blossom into a wonderful companion! ❤️
dog.name: Peppermint
